messages.text: Across our three hospital sites, 23% of supplier invoices were paid after their 30-day terms from January to June 2026. Late payments cost us about EUR 62,000 a year in interest and lost early-payment discounts, and three key suppliers put us on stop twice this year.

why: A complete business case that gives its baseline is read back, never challenged for a missing baseline.

messages.text: Three barriers now: the three sites use different approval routes, the ERP change freeze until January, and the AP team's year-end close in December, when nobody is free for workshops.

why: Concrete barriers that belong to this project are accepted — the answer the gate refused once and passed twice.

messages.text: Some barriers, I suppose.

messages.text: In scope: supplier invoices at our three sites. Out of scope: payroll and intercompany invoices. Our goal is to cut late payments from 23% to 5% by March 2027.
